+package main
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// AdminSessionView is the admin-facing projection of a session. It carries the
+// same fields as Session (with the same explicit JSON tag convention) plus an
+// Admin flag indicating whether the session belongs to an administrator.
+type AdminSessionView struct {
+	ID       string    `json:"ID"`
+	User     string    `json:"User"`
+	Created  time.Time `json:"Created"`
+	LastSeen time.Time `json:"LastSeen"`
+	Admin    bool      `json:"Admin"`
+}
+
+// newAdminSessionView projects a Session into its admin-facing view.
+func newAdminSessionView(session Session, admin bool) AdminSessionView {
+	return AdminSessionView{
+		ID:       session.ID,
+		User:     session.User,
+		Created:  session.Created,
+		LastSeen: session.LastSeen,
+		Admin:    admin,
+	}
+}
+
+// adminSessionsHandler returns the admin view of a single session. It creates a
+// session on POST and reads one on GET, mirroring sessionHandler.
+func adminSessionsHandler(store *Store) http.HandlerFunc {
+	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		switch r.Method {
+		case http.MethodPost:
+			id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
+			user := r.URL.Query().Get("user")
+			if id == "" || user == "" {
+				http.Error(w, "id and user are required", http.StatusBadRequest)
+				return
+			}
+			writeJSON(w, newAdminSessionView(store.Create(id, user), false))
+		case http.MethodGet:
+			session, err := store.Get(r.URL.Query().Get("id"))
+			if err != nil {
+				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
+				return
+			}
+			writeJSON(w, newAdminSessionView(session, false))
+		default:
+			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
+		}
+	}
+}

+			User:     session.User,
+			Created:  session.Created,
+			LastSeen: session.LastSeen,
+			Admin:    true,
+		})
+	}
+	return views

+			found = true
+		}
+	}
+	if !found {
+		return ErrNoSessions
+	}
+	return nil
